dedupeText: retro desert surrealism album cover 90s aesthetic surrealism desert landscape chrome lettering airstream trailer cowboy glowing aura the floating trailer acts as a central celestial object above the human figure the chrome typography at the top and bottom creates a heavy visual frame the yellow aura around the trailer contrasts with the deep blue and black night sky the desert elements like the cactus and road provide a grounded perspective for the surreal floating objects combine a dark landscape with a glowing central surreal object framed by heavy 3d chrome display type

recipe.visualDefinition: A surreal digital collage featuring a man in a cowboy hat standing in a dark desert landscape, with a metallic travel trailer floating above him surrounded by a yellow glow, framed by heavy chrome-effect typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The floating trailer acts as a central celestial object above the human figure.
The chrome typography at the top and bottom creates a heavy visual frame.
The yellow aura around the trailer contrasts with the deep blue and black night sky.
The desert elements like the cactus and road provide a grounded perspective for the surreal floating objects.
coreInvariants: Metallic chrome texture on primary text
Yellow glowing halo around the central floating object
Dark, saturated desert night color palette
Low-angle perspective of the human subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man in a cowboy hat is positioned in the lower right foreground, scaled to approximately half the height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The floating silver trailer in the upper center, emphasized by a bright yellow glow.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top chrome title, drop to the glowing trailer, follow the man's gaze, and land on the bottom nameplate.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black and dark blue sky in the upper corners and center-left provides breathing room for the collage elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy blue and black for the night sky and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow used exclusively for the aura/glow effect.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Chrome silver and red outlines for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark background and the bright, reflective metallic surfaces and glowing elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Bold, italicized sans-serif and script hybrids
letterConstructionRules: Heavy 3D extrusion with a downward-right drop shadow
Metallic gradient fill simulating chrome reflection
Red or orange thin outer stroke
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tightly kerned to the point of overlapping in the script-style bottom text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, arched sans-serif for the title paired with a fluid, connected chrome script for the name.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy weight and slanted profile for the top title.
Captures the connected, fluid motion of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A dark desert night scene with a road receding into the distance, a silhouette of a cactus on the right, and a man in a cowboy hat and dark jacket in the lower right. In the upper center, a silver airstream-style trailer floats, surrounded by a soft, vibrant yellow outer glow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, 3D chrome-textured text at the top with a slight arch and a red outline. Apply a large, italicized chrome script name at the bottom with a red outline and heavy black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a convincing metallic chrome gradient?
Is the man wearing a cowboy hat?
Is the background a dark desert night?

adjustableVariables: Curvature of the top text arch
mustRedesign: Avoid specific facial features of the original subject
Do not use the exact brand logo of the trailer
Ensure all text is generic or user-provided

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between glow and night sky

postGenerationChecks: Text must be legible despite the chrome effect
The trailer must appear to be floating, not resting on the ground
The red outline on the text must be sharp and visible
The overall composition must feel like a retro CD cover
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dark landscape with a glowing central surreal object, framed by heavy 3D chrome display type.
